fact: On 15 July 2022 the INPDP issued a statement that the Bolt app was in violation of the data protection law, naming Yassir, Glovo, Jumia and inDriver as well.
title: Tunisia: App-based delivery and rideshare companies accused of violating data protection law and failure to protect users privacy & personal information; incl. co. responses
publisher: Business and Human Rights Resource Centre
